info.name: RapidAid API
info.description:
# RapidAid — Emergency Response Platform

Priority-based ambulance dispatch, from emergency call to hospital arrival and payment.

## Getting started

1. Set the `baseUrl` variable (defaults to local: `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`).
2. Run **Auth → Login as Patient** (or Admin / Driver). The token is saved to `accessToken` automatically by a test script, and every other request inherits it.
3. Requests that need an id (`tripId`, `requestId`, …) pick it up automatically from the request that creates it.

## Seeded accounts

| Role | Email | Password |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Admin | admin@rapidaid.com | Admin@RapidAid2026 |
| Driver | driver1@rapidaid.com | Demo@RapidAid2026 |
| Patient | patient@rapidaid.com | Demo@RapidAid2026 |

## Roles

PATIENT raises emergencies and pays. DRIVER drives the trip state machine. ADMIN manages the fleet and dispatches.

## The happy path

Login as Patient → Create Emergency Request → (Admin) Dispatch → (Driver) status to EN_ROUTE_TO_PICKUP → PATIENT_PICKED_UP → Select Hospital → EN_ROUTE_TO_HOSPITAL → ARRIVED_AT_HOSPITAL → Complete Trip → (Patient) Init Payment.

item.name: Emergency Requests
item.description: Raising an emergency and dispatching an ambulance to it.

request.description: PATIENT only. One live request per patient. Coordinates are optional but must be given together.

{
  "pickupAddress": "House 12, Road 5, Dhanmondi, Dhaka",

  "pickupLng": 90.376,

  "priority": "CRITICAL",
  "requestedAmbulanceType": "ICU"
}

request.description: ADMIN sees every request, PATIENT sees only their own. Sorting by priority lists CRITICAL first.
The patient who raised it, or an admin.
PATIENT only, and only while the request is still PENDING.
PATIENT or ADMIN, only while PENDING.

ADMIN only. Runs in one transaction: claims the request, ambulance and driver with conditional updates, creates the trip, writes an audit log. Send an empty body to let the dispatcher choose, or name an ambulance and driver to override.

request.description: ADMIN only. Filter by status, driver and dispatch date range.

The assigned driver, the patient on the trip, or an admin.
DRIVER. First legal move out of DISPATCHED.
DRIVER. Stamps pickedUpAt.
DRIVER or ADMIN. Allowed any time before arrival, and required before heading to the hospital.
DRIVER. Rejected with a 400 if no hospital has been selected yet.
DRIVER. Stamps arrivedAt. The only state a trip can be completed from.
DRIVER or ADMIN. Hands the ambulance and driver back and cancels the request. A reason is required.
DRIVER. Only from ARRIVED_AT_HOSPITAL. One transaction: fare is baseFare + perKmRate x distanceKm, ambulance freed, driver back on duty, request COMPLETED, and a PENDING payment raised.

item.name: Payments
item.description: SSLCommerz checkout and the gateway callbacks. The callbacks are public and posted as form data.

request.description: PATIENT only, on their own completed and unpaid trip. Issues a fresh transaction id, stores it before redirecting, and returns gatewayPageURL. Open that URL in a browser to pay.

Public, posted by SSLCommerz as form data. The val_id is re-validated server side and the status, transaction id, currency and amount are all checked against the gateway before the bill is marked PAID. A repeat callback is a no-op.
Public. Marks a retriable bill FAILED. A PAID bill is never walked back.
Public. Marks a retriable bill CANCELLED.
Server to server, retried by SSLCommerz until it sees a 200. Settles the bill on its own when the browser redirect never arrives, and is idempotent with the success callback.
Public. Reports service name, environment and uptime.
